summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Staged 10 compile-safe permanent tests that are red by design until the spec is vendored and the client generated, plus 7 canImport-guarded stubbed-transport tests that activate with the generated module. Updated APIClientTests upload fixtures to the published-spec shape, exposing the hand-written client's drift (top-level scoring_algorithm_version, stats) as a failing assertion. Contract-delta analysis between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#113, merged 2026-10-30) is recorded in docs/openapi-client-test-plan.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so no tests could be executed here; swift test --disable-sandbox must run in CI on a macOS host.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to the iOS package; fetch or vendor the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.reason: Upstream spec confirmed published (viamin/color_matching#110 closed by PR #113, merged 2026-10-30; GET /api/v1/openapi.json). Tests are staged red against the missing artifacts (iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json, Package.swift wiring) and could not be executed because no Swift toolchain is installed in this container (swift: command not found).

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: test-sheet manifest + recent sheets, capture session creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

verification.reason: Spec-coverage test pins all six paths/methods/operationIds; guarded stubbed-response tests pin all six generated-client surfaces. Neither can run before the implementation run vendors the spec and generates the module; no Swift toolchain in this container.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace the app's hand-written API models with generated types; keep any purely client-side models as-is

verification.reason: Wiring test asserts APIClient.swift imports ColorMatchingOpenAPI and drops its four private hand-written wire DTOs (client-side models like CaptureMetadata/WhiteBalanceGains/PairJudgment and MeasurementCore models are intentionally allowed to stay, per the issue). Cannot execute without a Swift toolchain.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

verification.reason: Seven stubbed ClientTransport tests (six endpoints + typed 401 case) with zero network use are staged behind #if canImport(ColorMatchingOpenAPI); they activate and run in CI once the implementation run generates the module. The one drift-demonstrating test that CAN run today is APIClientTests.testUploadMeasurementsMatchesPublishedSpecShape (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/APIClientTests.swift:49), red because the current hand-written client sends the prose shape the published spec dropped. No Swift toolchain in this container, so not executed here.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records: what changed between the prose contract and the published spec, and any endpoint gaps discovered

verification.reason: Delta and gap analysis derived directly from the published spec sources (api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, router.ex, TestSheetController/CaptureController operations, TestSheetJSON renderer) fetched during this run; ready to be copied into the PR description.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exit criterion: swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types wired in

verification.reason: Cannot be met at this tests-only head by design: generated types do not exist yet (implementation run gated on paid-tests-approved). Additionally this container has no Swift toolchain, so the suite cannot run locally.
